mostWorthwhile.text: Ren's installed stop test was most worthwhile: it verified the safety function with the network disconnected, beyond the earlier bench test.

leastWorthwhile.text: The unsuccessful attempts to fit the sensor and use the key felt repetitive because the required preparation order was not yet apparent.

surprise.text: The test rig had no available operation at first, but became usable for the stop button once its service lead was fitted.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the local network controller before the independent stop felt like an unclear ordering constraint, although the feedback revealed the next operation.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the independent stop test and the working water service made the repair feel consequential, despite some opaque sequencing.
